name: DENT 5455
title: Scientific Writing
description: The basics of effective scientific writing in a six-week combined lecture and workshop format. Lectures cover scientific style, clarity in writing, development of hypothesis and organization of abstracts and manuscripts. Guest lectures and workshops provide specific direction in summarizing clinical, laboratory or social/biobehavioral research studies. Students are required to write and revise an extended abstract of their research and to present their abstract in small groups on the final class day.
requirement_description: Open only to current UConn Health Dental Residents in the combined Certificate/Master of Dental Science Program.
